rule: --mem = ceil(max(1.25 x measured peak, peak + 8 GB)); MemoryMax is a hard cap (an OOM kill restarts the step), so a step with no measurement keeps a larger value until its first run is measured. Admission already charges a running unit from its measured RSS after 5 min (books(): >=5 min now+max(now/2,4), >=30 min now+max(now/4,2)), so the request mainly sets the cap and the first-5-min charge.
